person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified NARA row supplies Carol F. Allen, civilian grade Caf-2, and Box 10. Common-name historical and modern results supplied no OSS link, civilian-grade connection, employer chronology, or second corroborating identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 10 for Carol F. Allen's full identity, Caf-2 duties, occupation, employer, and OSS recruitment chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The NARA row supplies Charles L. Allen, Sergeant, a private identifier, and Box 10. A same-name Army enlistment record carried a different private identifier, and other veteran records lacked an OSS or identifier match; none was assigned to this entity.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 10 and official Army records for Charles L. Allen's full identity, unit, occupation, last civilian employer, and OSS transfer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 10 to determine whether Desrae is the complete first name or an index spelling, and establish the Caf-2 employee's identity, duties, employer, and OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
